shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'for v in 15.48.2 15.47.1 15.46.1 15.45.0 15.44.0 15.43.0 15.42.0 15.41.1; do echo "--- $v"; npm view "@gravity-ui/markdown-editor@$v" peerDependencies dependencies --json; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'for v in 15.43.0 15.42.0 15.41.1 15.40.0 15.39.0; do echo -n "$v "; npm view "@gravity-ui/markdown-editor@$v" peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/components 2>/dev/null; done; npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.43.0'

/bin/bash -lc 'for v in 4.23.0 4.22.0 4.21.0 4.20.0 4.19.0 4.18.0 4.17.0 4.16.0 4.15.0 4.14.0 4.13.0 4.12.0 4.11.0 4.10.0; do echo -n "$v "; npm view "@gravity-ui/components@$v" peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null || true; done'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json'); console.log(p.version, p.types, JSON.stringify(p.exports))\" && rg -n \"export .*useMarkdownEditor|MarkdownEditorView|initial(?:Value|Content)|value.*string|mode\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor --glob '*.d.ts' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export .*RenderMarkdown|renderMarkdown|Markdown\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -100; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm -iname '*markdown*' -o -iname '*render*' | head -80; ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/build 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | head -80; find node_modules/@diplodoc/transform -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -80; rg -n \"export .*render|function render\" node_modules/@diplodoc/transform --glob '*.d.ts' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc 'find node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles -maxdepth 1 -type f | head; rg -n "export.*Button|declare const Button|function Button" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -20'
